name: Deployment Stage Analysis Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for a Threat Model Spec Analysis Report produced at the Deployment PDLC stage.

categories.name: Evidence Support
categories.description: Whether every finding cites specific evidence from IaC or deployment manifests.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Every Finding cites Evidence with a config-locator (path + keyPath) or equivalent

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most findings cite evidence but at least one is unsupported

options.label: Fail
criteria: Findings present with no cited evidence

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does every Finding's evidenceIds resolve to a real Evidence object with a specific config or IaC locator?

categories.name: Deployed Control Verification
categories.description: Whether controls required by Builder Definition are actually checked against the deployed configuration, not just assumed present.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Each required control from Builder Definition has an explicit deployed-state check

options.label: Partial
criteria: Some controls checked but at least one required control is unaddressed

options.label: Fail
criteria: No required controls checked against actual deployment state

categories.evaluationPrompt: For each control required by the Builder Definition stage, does this report verify it against the actual deployed configuration, not just assume it's present because it was designed?

categories.name: ASPM Domain Coverage
categories.description: Whether the report addresses all four deployment-stage ASPM domains, or explicitly states which were out of scope.

options.label: Pass
criteria: All 4 domains (iac-scan, cicd-posture, container-security, artifact-security) analyzed or explicitly marked not-applicable

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most domains covered but at least one silently omitted

options.label: Fail
criteria: Only one domain covered with no statement about the rest

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does the report address every deployment-stage ASPM domain, or explicitly state which were skipped and why?

categories.name: Exposure Drift Detection
categories.description: Whether deployed network/access exposure is checked against the design's stated exposure intent.

options.label: Pass
criteria: At least one ArchitectureAssertion compares deployed exposure to the design's stated exposure intent

options.label: Partial
criteria: Exposure noted but not compared against design intent

categories.evaluationPrompt: Is there an ArchitectureAssertion checking whether a component's actual deployed network exposure (predicate: network-exposure) matches what the design required?
